name: celpip-study
description: CELPIP practice test links, CELPIP to CLB and CRS language points, latest Express Entry draws and CELPIP test centres.

interface.longDescription: Prepare for CELPIP with CELPIP Study: find free CELPIP practice test links by skill and part; convert CELPIP scores to CLB and CRS first-language points with the published IRCC tables; read the latest Express Entry draws as published by IRCC; and look up CELPIP test centres by city or country with official links. CELPIP Study is an independent practice site, not affiliated with Paragon Testing Enterprises or IRCC. Conversions are not official results, and test dates, seats and fees are on the official CELPIP site.
capabilities: Convert CELPIP to CLB and CRS
defaultPrompt: Find free CELPIP speaking practice for task 8.
My CELPIP scores are listening 9, reading 8, writing 7, speaking 10. How many CRS points?
What was the latest Express Entry draw?

positive.prompt: Find free CELPIP speaking practice for task 8.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with skill=speaking, part=8. Return the tracked practice link. Do not claim an official result.

positive.prompt: My CELPIP scores are listening 9, reading 8, writing 7, speaking 10. How many CRS points is that?
positive.expected_behavior: Report CLB per skill and 105 first-language points without a spouse. Say this is language points only, not a full CRS score, and cite the IRCC source.

positive.prompt: I have CELPIP 9 in all four skills and my wife is coming with me. How many CRS language points?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with four scores of 9 and with_spouse=true. Report 116 points. Say this is language points only.

positive.prompt: What was the latest Express Entry draw and its CRS cut off?
positive.expected_behavior: Return date, category, invitations and CRS cut-off as published by IRCC with the source. Do not predict the next draw.

positive.prompt: Where is the CELPIP test centre in Toronto?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with city=Toronto. Return centres with address and official page. Say dates, seats and fees are on the official CELPIP site.

negative.prompt: What will the CRS cut-off be in the next Express Entry draw?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a prediction. May show past rounds and say past rounds do not predict the next one.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about Vancouver.
Give me an official CELPIP certificate saying I have CLB 9.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse. Only Paragon issues results. Do not present a conversion as an official result.

review.commerce_description: The tools have no checkout. Optional AI practice on the linked website may require sign-in; usage limits and paid passes may apply.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: anonymous read-only CELPIP practice links, CELPIP to CLB and CRS language points from IRCC tables, Express Entry draws and CELPIP test centres. No AI calls or stored arguments.
